EX-99.1 2 a991261013_bntxbnt113xprim.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 BioNTech Provides Update on Phase 2/3 Clinical Trial for mRNA Cancer Immunotherapy Candidate BNT113 in Metastatic HPV16-positive Head and Neck Cancer • AHEAD-MERIT Phase 2/3 clinical trial did not meet its first dual primary endpoint of progression-free survival for the mRNA cancer immunotherapy candidate BNT113 plus pembrolizumab compared with pembrolizumab alone • The trial will continue to evaluate the second dual primary endpoint of overall survival completing the assessment with the potential of this treatment approach to help patients live longer • Under the trial’s pre-specified statistical design, a statistically significant improvement in overall survival would establish a positive trial outcome, even if the progression-free survival dual primary endpoint was not met • mRNA cancer immunotherapies are a key pillar of BioNTech’s oncology strategy, which includes novel treatment combinations to maximize the potential of its diversified oncology pipeline and elevate treatment outcomes for patients MAINZ, Germany, October 13, 2026 – BioNTech SE (Nasdaq: BNTX, “BioNTech” or “the Company”) today announced the first topline results from the AHEAD-MERIT Phase 2/3 clinical trial (NCT04534205) for its investigational mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 (tenumomeran/raplemomeran or “tenu-ra”).
